Filing gate: ① (review follow-ups of a PR in flight). Shape per ruling B on #33718 (record 6891082225): one checklist card per reviewed PR; later reviews of PR #33736 append here. Dedupe: the open issues naming PR #33736 are its card #33604 and #33729 (a scope fence only).

## review follow-ups of PR #33736 (card #33604)

Records: 6891926185 (first), 6892305129 (delta), 6892689104 (delta, PASS on head `38cc292a`, nits only). Every item is a nit; the realistic record forms read right, and N4 fails closed.

- [ ] N1 a self-contradicting finding still clears: a bold title that is exactly "closed." followed by "Still open for the table cell" or "Reopened by this delta." in the body. The allowance also takes a `__` title, a tab, and an unpaired `.**`.
- [ ] N2 a hard line break directly after the state word inside a bold title clears (the rest of the title on the next line). No measured record wraps a finding title.
- [ ] N3 FAIL spellings still outside the reader: a header-row verdict column (needs table state), `Verdict: PASS → FAIL`, a struck PASS then FAIL, `Verdict was FAIL`, `verdict is: FAIL`, `Verdict -FAIL`, a mark before the cell's word, key and value in one cell, title or lower case in a heading tail.
- [ ] N4 clean text now refused (fail closed; a repost cures it): `The verdict is fail-closed.`, a table row with a verdict cell and a cell opening `fails closed`, a heading tail such as `PASS, prior FAIL closed`, a bare `FAILED` line.

`scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`, `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`; `skip-changeset`; `Clause-②: no`. Waits for PR #33736.
